items.t: "see if you can detect the scanner? I've installed the scanner now, so I feel like we should now focus on that next ... what can we do to better optimize its usage? ... is there a better open source uh, program that I can use besides the Epson Scan Smart thing? What are its disadvantages ... We need to create a good system, create the agents ... bolo this, glass it, and give me the fucking dope sheet."
Claude detected the EPSON ES-590W on USB. Windows lists it as Image class, status OK.
The box has Epson Scan 2 (TWAIN + WIA), ScanSmart 3.7.20, the Epson OCR components and Event Manager.
The box has Tesseract 5.4 (eng + osd), OCRmyPDF and Ghostscript. NAPS2 is not installed.
Claude wrote the research file `_tools/scanner/research.md` from web sources only.
Claude built the agent `.claude/agents/scan-reader.md` (sonnet). It writes handwriting transcripts from page images.
Claude built the agent `.claude/agents/scan-filer.md` (haiku). It writes one filing.json per batch: title, date, bin, tags, ties.
The drop folder `Q:\_PDF_DROP\paper` exists from BOLO 107. Chief held the paper scans until the scanner came.
The research verdict: use NAPS2 to scan. It is free, open source, and drives the scanner through TWAIN or WIA.
The research verdict: use OCRmyPDF for typed text. It fixes tilt and rotation and writes a searchable PDF/A.
ScanSmart's flaws, from Epson's own docs: the auto file names can carry an old date, and OCR can fail.
ScanSmart's flaws, from Epson's own docs: cloud sending can break. It is closed source, and the research found no scripting.
Tesseract is weak on handwriting. The plan sends handwriting to a vision model that reads whole page images.
Nothing is tested yet. NAPS2 on the ES-590W, the vision reader's accuracy and the carrier sheet fit are all unverified.
Bound notepads do not feed through the sheet feeder. Chief tears out the pages or photographs them.

Chief, 10/17: "before every document that I scan ... take that text ... and then attach it to that document ... I'll say the document, then you'll clean it up, and then you'll attach it, and then I'll scan it".

paragraphs.main_effort: Replace ScanSmart with NAPS2 and build the hot-folder pipeline, so a scanned page reaches the intake without a person at the screen.

phases.t: **Scanner detected.** Claude found the ES-590W on USB with its Epson drivers, plus Tesseract, OCRmyPDF and Ghostscript.
**Research written.** Claude covered ScanSmart's flaws, open-source options, settings per material, the pipeline and handwriting in `_tools/scanner/research.md`.
**Agents built.** Claude wrote `scan-reader` (sonnet) and `scan-filer` (haiku). A script applies the filing, and RANGE checks it.
**Glass and this sheet.** Claude shows Chief the board and builds DOPE SHEET 149, as Chief ordered.
**Test scan.** Claude installs NAPS2 and scans one page over USB with TWAIN. The research marks this path unverified.
**Scan profiles.** Claude saves one NAPS2 profile per material: typed pages, handwriting, photos, receipts. Handwriting scans at 300 dpi color, lossless.
**Watcher script.** A small Python script polls `_scan_in/` and waits until the file size stops changing. It copies each raw scan to `_scan_raw/`.
**Typed-page step.** The script runs OCRmyPDF with `--deskew --rotate-pages --clean` on typed material. It names files `YYYY-MM-DD_source_batch_NNN`.
**Dedupe.** The script hashes each raw scan with SHA-256, plus a perceptual hash for near-duplicates. This is the research's own suggestion.
**Handwriting test.** Claude runs `scan-reader` on 20 real pages. The reader marks unclear words `[?]`. Chief spot-checks.
**Filing script.** Claude builds the script that applies each filing.json. Then it files into the intake's paper and scripts bins.

agent (sonnet): faithful handwriting transcripts from page images
the paper drop folder from BOLO 107

untouched copies of every raw scan (named in the research)
one command scans the next document (typed · hand · photo · receipt) through NAPS2 over TWAIN, OCRs typed pages, attaches the waiting blurb
the voice blurb queue: Claude cleans what Chief says, the next scan takes the oldest blurb as context.md, PDF Subject/Keywords and an embedded file
one folder per document: raw.pdf · doc.pdf · doc.txt · context.md

cost.v: none spent in the sources · NAPS2, OCRmyPDF and Tesseract are free
Epson carrier sheet, part B12B819051, for creased or thin originals · a seller does not list the ES-590W as compatible, so check first
100-sheet feeder · 600 dpi optical · 215.9 mm wide maximum
the research prefers a local vision model, because a cloud model would send private notes off the box
